legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc.
legal_units.text: Where a person, who is required to deliver or causes to be delivered a statement prescribed in section 397(3)(b),— the Assessing Officer may impose on such person, a penalty of a sum which shall not be less than Rs. 10000 but which may extend to Rs. 100000.
